unclear.text: Resale before the coverage deadline (reg. 14 against reg. 9(3))
readings: U1-a: transfers are allowed at any time with consent (reg. 14); reg. 9(3) only states the purpose of the obligation
U1-b: reg. 9(3) bars any transfer until the obligation is met or the deadline passes

a1.text: Some blocks are bid at or above the reserve: bidders expect a license to be worth more than M40 million after the build-out cost.

a3.text: The obligation is enforced: revocation is credible, so licensees build to 90% by the end of 2032.

a8.text: Licensees would not, on their own, cover 90% of the population with the band by 2032 (about 65% commercially).

a17.text: Some operators win blocks at prices below their own value for them (the cap holds the clearing price at the third-highest bidder's value).

a28.text: Investors expected the award partly from the March 2026 consultation and fully from 1 March 2027.

a30.text: A license is revoked and the band re-auctioned.

j1.text: The reserve price of M40 million a block binds: some blocks would sell for less without it.

j2.text: Households outside the cities and large towns value mobile coverage from the band.
